name: validate-row-point-in-time
body: validate_row validates a point-in-time git read with no lock held, so a worktree removed or re-pointed between validation and use is not re-detected, and a row must name git's own worktree name, so an alias for a differently named worktree is refused; re-validate at the consumer's open and accept aliases only if rows may ever alias a worktree.
